why: The browser suites run on this frozen data build, not on whatever the weekly refresh last published, so a rebuild cannot fail the deploy gate by moving what a test aims at. Moving the pin is deliberate: publish a snapshot as a new asset on the test-data release, update asset and sha256 here, and fix whatever tests the new data moves, in the same commit. The published data is still checked on every deploy by the @live tests (npm run e2e:live).
